evidence_boundary: Retrospective method development/protocol sensitivity only; historical outer labels were previously inspected. Not a new blind test or prospective confirmation.
residual_standardization: source auxiliary train residual mean and population SD only

selection.gate: both destination test cap16 corrected regret values must be strictly lower than frozen CNN

split.method: H1 connected components after exact/H1 exclusion of union T-cell r1/r2 and Sample train/dev/calibration

auxiliary_pools: sha256(context|split|sequence) ascending; complete nonoverlapping pools of 64; deterministic seeded uniform proposals with replacement
affine_negative_control: fit p and intercept with the selected full-model lambda and strength per direction; require positive final effective slope; evaluate the mathematically invariant frozen-CNN ranking so floating-point tie perturbations do not create artificial selection differences; retain transformed scores

target.bootstrap_cluster: pool; combined analysis resamples all 32 pools
success: both repeat cap16 corrected-minus-frozen mean regret differences are negative
combined pool-cluster bootstrap 95th percentile CI upper bound is below zero
combined absolute mean regret reduction is at least max(0.1 MRL, 5 percent of combined frozen baseline regret)
all isolation, CUDA, numerical, training and calibration logs pass

forbidden: No T-cell MRL for training, calibration, feature/lambda/strength/subset selection, early stopping, gating, or method changes. No post-target scientific changes.
local_export: Aggregates, coefficients, configs, code and logs only; no sequence strings or sequence-level labels/predictions.
